in_plain_words: Addresses that forward in a circle
what_to_do: Ask your developer to fix the forwarding rules.
title: Redirect loops
evidence: chain: [{url: http://127.0.0.1:58769/loop-a, status: 301, location: http://127.0.0.1:58769/loop-b}, {url: http://127.0.0.1:58769/loop-b, status: 301, location: http://127.0.0.1:58769/loop-a}]
why: A loop makes the URL unreachable for users and search engines.
fix: Fix the redirect rules so the URL resolves to a 200 page.

in_plain_words: Main-address tags that point to a broken page
what_to_do: Point the tag at the correct, working address.

why: A canonical to an error or redirect is ignored and confuses indexing.
fix: Point the canonical at the live, final (200) version of the page.

in_plain_words: Important pages hidden from Google

in_plain_words: Pages fit on mobile phones
what_to_do: Ask your designer to add the mobile 'viewport' setting.
title: Missing or incorrect viewport meta tag
why: Without a responsive viewport the page fails mobile-friendliness (mobile-first indexing).
fix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">.

in_plain_words: The site is secure (padlock)
what_to_do: Ask your developer to set up HTTPS and forward all visitors to it.
title: HTTPS and HTTP→HTTPS redirect
evidence: https_probe: {error: ConnectError: [SSL: WRONG_VERSION_NUMBER] wrong version number (_ssl.c:1035), final_url: https://127.0.0.1:58769/}; https_available: False
why: HTTPS is a ranking signal and browsers flag HTTP pages as 'Not secure'.
fix: Serve the site over HTTPS and 301-redirect every HTTP URL to its HTTPS version.

in_plain_words: Language versions set up correctly
what_to_do: Ask your developer to correct the language tags.
title: Hreflang errors
evidence: problems: [{problem: No x-default alternate (recommended), severity: info}, {href: http://127.0.0.1:58769/de/, status: 404, problem: Alternate URL does not return 200, redirects: 0}]
why: Invalid hreflang annotations are ignored, so the wrong language version may rank.
fix: Use valid ISO codes, include a self-reference, make every alternate link back, and point only at 200 canonical URLs.

in_plain_words: Addresses that forward several times
what_to_do: Make old addresses forward straight to the final page.
title: Redirect chains (more than one hop)

Redirect 301 /old-page http://127.0.0.1:58769/new-page

location = /old-page { return 301 http://127.0.0.1:58769/new-page; }
why: Each extra hop slows users and crawlers; long chains may not be followed.

in_plain_words: Pages with server errors

in_plain_words: Pages that didn't load

in_plain_words: Wrong addresses show a 'page not found' message

fix: Return HTTP 404 (or 410) for unknown URLs; for single-page apps configure the host's fallback to send a 404 status for unknown routes.

in_plain_words: Server answers quickly
